{
  "name": "effortless",
  "version": "1.69.0",
  "description": "Sets the reasoning effort for every prompt automatically, shows it under the prompt box, and counts down how long the prompt cache stays warm.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "judge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Judge",
      "description": "Haiku (your own Claude login, no key) always judges handoffs and, unless Jev answers, the effort. auto: Jev as well when a TypeSafe key is set. haiku: Haiku only. jev: Jev as well, and its key may also come from ~/.config/jev/.env.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "haiku",
        "jev"
      ]
    },
    "typesafeKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key (optional, only for jev)",
      "description": "For the jev judge. Stored as a secret by Claude Code. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used, and with judge set to jev also ~/.config/jev/.env.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "handoffSkill": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff skill (optional)",
      "description": "A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: effortless writes it itself (checks git, saves HANDOFF.md). Quick is always a fast fork with the built-in prompt.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "handoffAfter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After a handoff (first choice)",
      "description": "What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff.",
      "default": "continue",
      "options": [
        "continue",
        "confirm",
        "copy"
      ]
    },
    "effortBias": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Effort slider",
      "description": "-2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.",
      "default": "0",
      "options": [
        "-2",
        "-1",
        "0",
        "1",
        "2"
      ]
    },
    "effortFloor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Never below",
      "description": "Auto never picks a lower effort than this.",
      "default": "low",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "effortCeiling": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Never above",
      "description": "Auto never picks a higher effort than this.",
      "default": "max",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ]
    },
    "hide": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Switched off",
      "description": "Comma-separated: handoff (the footer button), timer (the cache countdown), reason (the judge's line). The alert bands always show. Empty shows everything. The judge's line is off unless switched on.",
      "default": "reason"
    },
    "modelAuto": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cheaper model when it can (experimental)",
      "description": "on: a prompt the judge calls simple may run on a cheaper model (Haiku 5.5 or Sonnet), never above the chat's own, when the switch pays. It rarely does in a chat that is in use: the other model rereads the whole chat. off (default): every prompt runs on the chat's model.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "handoffButton": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff button",
      "description": "advised: the button is Compact, and turns into a glowing Handoff when Haiku says a fresh chat would pay off. always: the button is always Handoff.",
      "default": "advised",
      "options": [
        "advised",
        "always"
      ]
    },
    "compactWith": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Compact with",
      "description": "haiku: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary when the chat is compacted (far cheaper). session: the chat's own model, as Claude Code does it.",
      "default": "haiku",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "session"
      ]
    },
    "swampAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Swamped at",
      "description": "The swamp band shows once the context fills this percent of the window.",
      "default": "50",
      "options": [
        "10",
        "20",
        "30",
        "40",
        "50",
        "60",
        "70",
        "80"
      ]
    },
    "appearance": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Appearance",
      "description": "auto: light panels when Claude Code's theme is light, dark otherwise. dark and light fix it.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "dark",
        "light"
      ]
    },
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "The accent colour of everything effortless draws. violet: the brand colour. orange: Claude Code orange. rose: cherry-blossom pink, with falling petals.",
      "default": "violet",
      "options": [
        "violet",
        "orange",
        "rose"
      ]
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Look",
      "description": "default: a dashboard band above the prompt (effort, Auto, cache, context, handoff). minimal: small buttons in the footer, no band.",
      "default": "default",
      "options": [
        "default",
        "minimal"
      ]
    }
  }
}
